module: Manages game markers in freeroam/career (missions, parkings, zones, gas stations, etc.). It groups the raw POIs of gameplay_rawPois into clusters by marker type (factories in gameplay/markers/<type>.lua), creates a cluster's marker object on demand, and provides the two icon renderers (BeamNGWorldIconsRenderer) for the world and the big map. A 2D kd-tree is used to find the visible clusters around a position.
notes: Clusters are invalidated as soon as gameplay_rawPois.getRawPoiGeneration() increases.
Marker types handled: missionMarker, parkingMarker, zoneMarker, walkingMarker, gasStationMarker, driftLineMarker, invisibleTrigger, inspectVehicleMarker, crawlMarker, vehicleTrigger (hardcoded list).
Both icon renderers are deleted at the end of the level and at serialization (Lua reload).
The icon renderers are created lazily by the getters; the world renderer loads the core/art/gui/images/iconAtlas atlas.

validPlaymodeMarkersStates.desc: Game states where markers are active: freeroam and career. Modifiable to add more.

clear.desc: Clears the clusters, the kd-tree and deletes the created marker objects.

getIconRendererId.desc: Id of the BeamNGWorldIconsRenderer object 'markerIconRenderer' (created if needed).

getIconRendererObj.desc: World icon renderer object (created if needed).

getBigmapRendererId.desc: Id of the big map icon renderer 'bigmapIconRenderer' (created if needed).

getBigmapRendererObj.desc: Big map icon renderer object (created if needed).

getPlaymodeClusters.desc: List, sorted by id, of the marker clusters of the current level (computed then cached). Each cluster must have id, visibilityPos and visibilityRadius, otherwise an error is logged.

getPlaymodeClustersAsQuadtree.desc: 2D kd-tree (kdtreebox2d) of the clusters, indexed by a box enclosing visibilityPos ± visibilityRadius.

getMarkerForCluster.desc: Returns the cluster's marker object; creates it on the first call (cluster.create(), createObjects, setup).

isStateWithPlaymodeMarkers.desc: Indicates whether the current game state is in validPlaymodeMarkersStates.

onClientStartMission.desc: Level start hook: creates the two icon renderers.

onClientEndMission.desc: Level end hook: clears clusters and markers, deletes the icon renderers.

onSerialize.desc: Hook before Lua reload: same cleanups as onClientEndMission.
